description: This file defines the database schema for the Career Navigator project, creating tables, types, indexes, and extensions related to roles, competencies, user profiles, plans, evidence, and role adjacency graphs, primarily for managing career development data.
calls: create extension if not exists "pgcrypto"
create extension if not exists "uuid-ossp"
create type plan_item_kind as enum ('competency', 'skill', 'general')
create type evidence_type as enum ('file', 'link', 'note')
create table if not exists public.roles
create table if not exists public.competencies
create table if not exists public.role_competencies
create table if not exists public.role_adjacency
create table if not exists public.profiles
create table if not exists public.profile_competencies
create table if not exists public.plans
create table if not exists public.plan_items
create table if not exists public.evidence
create index if not exists idx_role_competencies_role
create index if not exists idx_role_competencies_comp
create index if not exists idx_role_adjacency_source
create index if not exists idx_role_adjacency_target
create index if not exists idx_profiles_current_role
create index if not exists idx_profiles_target_role
create index if not exists idx_profile_comp_profile
create index if not exists idx_profile_comp_comp
create index if not exists idx_plans_profile
create index if not exists idx_plan_items_plan
create index if not exists idx_evidence_profile
create index if not exists idx_evidence_comp
